name: RBFS switches branches and re-expands A (IDA* bounds 5, 6, 7)
note: Monotone, admissible h; optimal path S-A-C-G = 7. RBFS dives into A (F = 5), sees that C has F = 7 > the alternative B (F = 6), backs 7 up to A and switches to B; B's child D has F = 8 > 7, so 8 is backed up to B and the search returns to A, which is EXPANDED AGAIN (5 expansions, A twice; A* needs 4). IDA* on the same graph runs with bounds 5, 6, 7.
